text:
anya: Heads-up: bringing Zephyr-v1 (fp32 -> q8) onto staging revealed a weird detok/regression for CJK date/numeric ranges. Filing thread here.
sam: quick repro? is it tokenization or model hallucination? :thinking_face:
anya: tiny repro below. fp32 ok, q8 shows extra spacing and sometimes duplicated year token in the english detok.
li: ```
src: 我们将在2024-03-10至2024-03-15之间迁移。
ref: We will migrate between 2024-03-10 and 2024-03-15.
zephyr-q8: We will migrate from 2024 年 3 月 10 日 到 2024 年 3 月 15 日 2024.
zephyr-fp32: We will migrate between 2024-03-10 and 2024-03-15.
```
anya: BLEU drop ~5.6 on the date-heavy slice. The q8 english output inserts a year token twice and adds fullwidth spacing around month/day pieces.
jorge: can you paste token/detok dumps? might be a boundary flip around hyphen/ndash or numeric runs.
anya: token dump (zephyr tok): `[CLS] 我 们 将 在 2024 - 03 - 10 至 2024 - 03 - 15 之 间 迁 移 。 [SEP]`
sam: hyphens are separate subtokens -> detok currently joins without removing extra spaces in q8 path. Any runtime differences (kv-cache, reflow)?
li: check logs for fallback/reflow flags. small shifts in subtoken logits from quantization can change boundary decisions and thus detok behavior.
anya: logs show `reflow_patch=true` for some q8 requests; not present on fp32. suspect kernel selection bump triggered fallback path.
infra-bot: q8 build 4829 used kernel-set v2.6.0 (matmul tiling updated).
jorge: that matches hypothesis. plan: run shadow-roundtrip eval on numeric/date variants across locales and bisect kernel/commit.
ci-bot: ci:trigger shadow-roundtrip --slice date_numeric_variants --models zephyr-fp32,zephyr-q8 --env staging
sam: short-term mitigation: add conservative post-detok normalizer for date ranges (regex-based) to collapse duplicated year tokens and normalize spacing. Ugly but quick for canary.
li: agree; also add this slice to nightly regressions and block q8 canary until bisect finishes.
anya: starting bisect now to pin the kernel change. will post kernel id / commit when found and coordinate revert test with infra.
jorge: infra, can you run a revert-build with previous kernel-set and confirm regression disappears? @infra-bot
infra-bot: acknowledged. scheduling revert-build test and will post results in this thread.
ci-bot: shadow-roundtrip queued (job 24711). ETA ~15m.
